classes.name: Statistics
classes.description: PHP class providing methods to manage statistics data stored in the database within the Opencart system.

methods.name: getStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves all records from the 'statistics' database table as an array.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Fetches the value associated with a specific code from the 'statistics' table.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Increments the value associated with a specific code in the 'statistics' table.

methods.name: removeValue
methods.description: Decrements the value associated with a specific code in the 'statistics' table.

methods.name: editValue
methods.description: Sets a specific value for a given code in the 'statistics' table.
